description: Incoming health-check settings parsing. The incoming section of a node's settings may carry a health-check definition with an optional path and cluster name. The cluster name defaults to a fixed value when not provided. A health check counts as 'custom' only when a non-blank path is configured; an absent or empty path yields an empty path and a non-custom health check. Output reports the resolved cluster name, the path, and whether the health check is custom.
